description: Anchor a THIRD PARTY's exact claim bytes, unmodified and unjudged. Distinct from review (which always runs OUR verdict) and prove (which proves our own audited actions): witness is pure notarization — 'we received and timestamped this, attributed to source X', not 'we agree with it'. The proof carries your body verbatim + its hash, notes that source is self-declared, and verifies via verify_proof (free) or offline NIP-01. Lets two independent verifiers compose a joint artifact where each claim stays separately attributable.

body.description: The exact claim to anchor, byte-for-byte (max 16000 chars)

source.description: Who this claim is attributed to (self-declared, NOT verified by us)

name: witness
